openneuro 0.99.0

openneuro

Search, explore, and download datasets from OpenNeuro using its GraphQL API. Returns tidy tibbles, supports BIDS-aware file indexing, and handles selective downloads with local caching.

Installation 

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("alz-io/openneuro")

Usage

Search for datasets 

library(openneuro)

search_datasets(modality = "mri", n = 5)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 12
#>   id       name     public version subjects modalities tasks  dataset_name
#>   <chr>    <chr>    <lgl>  <chr>      <int> <list>     <list> <chr>
#> 1 ds008064 Individ… TRUE   1.0.0         28 <list [1]> <list> Individuali…
#> 2 ds008055 Scienti… TRUE   1.0.0        108 <list [1]> <list> Scientific …
#> 3 ds008039 learnin… TRUE   1.0.0         70 <list [1]> <list> learning-ha…
#> 4 ds008034 Action … TRUE   1.0.0         34 <list [1]> <list> Action Repr…
#> 5 ds008018 Personal… TRUE   1.0.0         38 <list [1]> <list> Personality…

Filter by task, species, diagnosis, subject count, or author:

search_datasets(
  modality  = "eeg",
  task      = "stroop",
  min_subjects = 30
)

Get dataset metadata 

meta <- get_metadata("ds000001")
meta$title
#> [1] "Balloon Analog Risk-taking Task"
meta$n_subjects
#> [1] 16
meta$tasks
#> [1] "balloon analog risk task"
meta$readme |> substr(1, 200)
#> [1] "This dataset was obtained from the OpenfMRI project
#>      (http://www.openfmri.org).\nAccession #: ds000001\n..."

List files 

# Top-level directory
list_files("ds000001")
#> # A tibble: 23 × 6
#>   id           filename               size directory annexed url
#>   <chr>        <chr>                 <dbl> <lgl>     <lgl>   <chr>
#> 1 bd0bead8ffa… CHANGES                 286 FALSE     FALSE   https://…
#> 2 b6aff27bdd1… README                 1175 FALSE     FALSE   https://…
#> 3 17b93025e53… dataset_description…   615 FALSE     FALSE   https://…
#> 4 436793806e0… participants.tsv       216 FALSE     FALSE   https://…
#> 5 db72baeb366… sub-01                    0 TRUE      FALSE   NA

# Full recursive listing
all_files <- list_files("ds000001", recursive = TRUE)
all_files
#> # A tibble: 136 × 6

Download files

Download entire datasets or just specific subjects:

download_dataset("ds000001", subjects = c("01", "02"),
                 dest_dir = "data")

Or pick individual files using dplyr-style filtering:

all_files <- list_files("ds000001", recursive = TRUE)

t1w <- all_files[grep("T1w", all_files$filename), ]
download_files(t1w, dest_dir = "data", dataset_id = "ds000001")

BIDS-aware file indexing

Parse BIDS entities from file listings:

idx <- bids_index(all_files)
idx[idx$subject == "01" & idx$suffix == "bold", ]
#> # A tibble: 4 × 11
#>   filename           subject session task   suffix extension
#>   <chr>              <chr>   <chr>   <chr>  <chr>  <chr>
#> 1 sub-01/func/sub-0… 01      NA      ballo… bold   .nii.gz
#> 2 sub-01/func/sub-0… 01      NA      ballo… events .tsv
#> 3 sub-01/func/sub-0… 01      NA      ballo… bold   .nii.gz
#> 4 sub-01/func/sub-0… 01      NA      ballo… events .tsv

Manage the cache 

openneuro_cache(info = TRUE)
#> OpenNeuro cache directory: /home/user/.cache/R/openneuro
#> > 0 cached files
#> > Total size: 0 bytes

openneuro_cache(path = "~/my_openneuro_data")

API

Function What it does
search_datasets() Query by modality, species, task, diagnosis, subject count, author, etc.
get_metadata() Dataset title, DOI, subjects, tasks, readme, grant info, validation
list_files() Recursive file tree with size, annex status, and download URLs
download_files() Download specific files by URL list
download_dataset() Download full dataset — optionally filter by subject
bids_index() Parse BIDS entities (subject, session, task, run, suffix) from filenames
openneuro_cache() Inspect, set, or clear the local download cache

Notes

  • The advancedSearch GraphQL endpoint is used for search. Public datasets that produce permission errors are silently skipped with a warning.
  • File downloads use the S3 URLs returned by the API. Versioned S3 objects are handled automatically.
  • The local cache directory defaults to tools::R_user_dir("openneuro", "cache") and can be overridden with the OPENNEURO_CACHE_DIR environment variable.
